mapping.promptSource: docs/缺陷卡生图提示词_精简版.md
workflow: Generate one defect card at a time.
Verify prompt injection before each generation.
Use size:auto so the 2:3 portrait canvas is inferred from the prompt.
Verify the matching task card before extraction.
Extract the web preview without printing base64 into chat context.
Save the raw web preview and a unified 2:3 cropped preview.
Mark the slot ready immediately after local file extraction.
Keep generated asset paths relative to the site root.

slots.promptBrief: single troll-blood adventurer with a huge frightening silhouette, dragging a cracked club too heavy to lift cleanly, green regeneration magic sealing old cracks across the skin.
single dragonborn adventurer kneeling beside a dim brazier, ember smoke leaking from the mouth instead of a full breath weapon.
single dwarf heir holding an ancestral hammer across both arms, tired eyes, heavy clan runes glowing on the weapon.
single elegant elf under cold moonlight, translucent silver veins like fragile glass filaments, cracked crystal goblet floating nearby.
single powerful adventurer with glowing red stamina runes cracking across armor straps, visible steam from breath and shoulders.
single small halfling or gnome adventurer crouched under an oversized shield in heavy rain, tiny campfire burning impossibly bright beside them.
single giant-blood adventurer calmly squeezing through a narrow dungeon gate, massive shoulders scraping stone.
single tiefling warlock with glowing contract scars across arms and collarbone, arcane bandages floating like binding clauses.
single adventurer sitting awake beside a bedroll, shadow of a dream demon leaning over the sleeping space, blue campfire almost extinguished.
single tough adventurer stepping through glowing trap runes while calmly eating from a cursed stew bowl, green magical fumes curling unnoticed.
single lawful knight or veteran guard binding an old wound before marching, oath badge glowing on the cloak.
